(d)
all actions and proceedings instituted by or against
the  Rehabilitation  of  Persons,  Properties  and
Industries  Authority  established  under  section  2
of  the  repealed  Act,  and  pending  on  the  date  of
commencement of this Act, shall, with effect from
the date of  commencement of this Act, be deemed
to be actions and proceedings as the case may be,
instituted by or against the Office for Reparations
established  under section 3 of this Act and may
accordingly  be continued and completed;

(e)
all judgments and orders made in favour or against
the  Rehabilitation  of  Persons,  Properties    and
Industries  Authority  established  under  section  2
of the repealed Act, and  remaining unsatisfied on
the  day  immediately  preceding  the  date  of
commencement of this Act, shall, with effect from
the date of commencement of this Act, be deemed
to  be  judgements  and  orders  made  in  favour  or
against  the  Office  for  Reparations  established
under  section  3  of  this  Act  and  be  enforced
accordingly;
